name: Ashtanga Yoga Brussels
reason: Too thin: its own site (ashtanga.be, a WordPress.com site; robots.txt allows us) is a small traditional shala (Anne and Evangeline Pinette, Damien Meadows; Place Jean Jacobs, Brussels) whose only item with a page of its own is the schedule and class-pass prices (drop-in Euro 22 to monthly Euro 160); the beginners page is general advice, the events link is a dead page (404), and there are no workshops, trainings, retreats or free resources. It has a published email (annepinette@yahoo.com) and a contact form, so it could return if it adds programmes.
